title: Romania – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Achizitie publica de produse (echipamente generale de laborator)
description: Titlu: Echipamente generale de laborator (divizate pe loturi) Legislația aplicabilă: Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achizițiile publice, cu modificările şi completările ulterioare și Hotărârea Guvernului nr. 395/2016 pentru aprobarea Normelor metodologice de aplicare a prevederilor referitoare la atribuirea contractului de achiziție publică/acordului-cadru din Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achizițiile publice Divizare pe loturi: DA (21 de loturi). Fiecare lot, cu exceptia Lot nr. 1, include cate un echipament specific de laborator [Lot 2- moara centrifugala de laborator, Lot 3- centrifuga de laborator, Lot 4- etuva de uscare cu vid, Lot 5- liofilizator de laborator, Lot 6- Vâscozimetru rotațional, Lot 7- Camera creștere plante, Lot 8- Evaporator rotativ (rotavapor), Lot 9- Titrator automat, Lot 10- Baie cu ultrasunete , Lot 11- Centrifugă de laborator, Lot 12- Granulator, Lot 13- Baie de apă termostatată, Lot 14- Bidistilor automat, Lot 15- Congelator stocare probe, Lot 16- Nișă chimică de laborator, Lot 17- Instalație automată pentru demineralizare apă/demineralizator/dedurizator, Lot 18- Digestor cu microunde, Lot 19- Baie de nisip pentru laborator, Lot 20- Digestor termostatat (Kjeldahl) si Lot 21- Aparat determinare pH, conductivitate (Multiparametru)]. Lotul nr. 1 (Lot 1) este alcătuit din 2 echipamente de laborato cu funcții similare (Balanță tehnică de precizie și Balanță analitică). Tip contract: contract de achiziție publică de produse Durată contract: maxim 4 luni de la semnarea contractului de către ambele părți Valoarea totală estimată: 748.600 lei fără TVA. cheltuielile fiind asigurate din fonduri europene, respectiv din proiectul intitulat ”Fertilizanți inovativi cu eliberare controlată pentru o agricultură durabilă (acronim AGROINOFERT)”, Cod proiect: SMIS 336222, Contract: Nr. 530 / 12.11.2025, Program de finanțare „Regiunea Centru” 2021-2027, PRC/525/PRC_P1/OP1. Procedură selectată: licitație deschisă Justificare necesitate achiziție: în cadrul acestei proceduri vor fi achiziționate produse necesare efectuării activităților de cercetare, dezvoltare și inovare în scopul asigurării atingerii obiectivelor și indicatorilor de realizare și rezult atribuite proiectului de cercetare definit mai sus. Utilizarea echipamentele propuse spre achiziționare este definită de următoarele aspecte: ♦ preparare, caracterizare, furnizare și conservare/stocare mostre de hidrolizate proteice și complecșii acestora cu microelemente esențiale cu rol de biostimulatori pentru fertilizanți; derivați ureo-aldehidici cu eliberare controlată de azot și componenți hidrofobizanți pe bază de sulf petrolier; ♦ elaborare tehnologie de laborator TRL 4 pentru obținerea de componenți hidrofobizanți pe bază de sulf petrolier, intermediari în recepturile de fertilizanți inovativi cu eliberare controlată (efectuarea experimentărilor de realizare a formulărilor de fertilizanți inovativi); ♦ efectuare experimentări de optimizare a parametrilor tehnologici de obținere a componenților hidrofobizanți pe bază de sulf petrolier; ♦ elaborare Tehnologie TRL 6 de obținere a fertilizanților inovativi cu eliberare controlată, cu conținut de Sulf petrolier și biostimulatori (efectuarea experimentelor și optimizarea tehnologiei); ♦ caracterizare analitică a intermediarilor și fertilizanților inovativi obținuți și stocarea/conservarea acestora; ♦ testare biologică și agrochimică a recepturilor de fertilizanți inovativi în camera de creștere propusă spre achiziționare.

buyer: East Midlands Ambulance Service NHS Trust
title: Private Ambulance Service (PAS) 2027
description:
East Midlands Ambulance Service NHS Trust (“EMAS”) is issuing this invitation to tender (ITT) under the provider selection regime (PSR), competitive process for the provision of Private Ambulance services where needed.

The intention is to award as separate lots and providers may bid for one or more of the lots if they are able to provide the necessary service within that area. This tender is based upon additional resource to EMAS using double crewed ambulance under blue light with a mix of Paramedic, Technicians and Emergency Care Assistants (ECA).

There is a total of 4 lots associated with this procurement as follow:
Lot 1 - South Lincolnshire
Lot 2 - Leicestershire
Lot 3 - Nottinghamshire and Derbyshire
Lot 4 - Northamptonshire

Providers must be CQC registered and hold all relevant licences required for carrying out this work.

The contract is for a 12 month period commencing on 1st April 2027 with an option to extend 12 months.

This is a Provider Selection Regime (PSR) Contract Notice. The awarding of this contract is subject to the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023. For the avoidance of doubt, the provisions of the Public Contracts Regulations 2015 or the Procurement Act 2024 do not apply to this award.

title: Felles EPJ for den offentlige tannhelsetjenesten
description: Konkurransen gjelder levering av en felles elektronisk pasientjournal (EPJ) for den offentlige tannhelsetjenesten, med integrasjon mot felles lagringsløsning. Løsningen leveres som en løpende tjeneste som inkluderer drift, utvikling og forvaltning. Anskaffelsens verdi anslås til over EØS terskelverdi. Volumet er et estimat og er ikke bindende for oppdragsgiver. For nærmere informasjon viser vi til anskaffelsesdokumentene. Et utkast til selve konkurransegrunnlaget er lagt ved dette kvalifiseringsgrunnlaget. Oppdragsgiver forbeholder seg retten til å foreta mindre, ikke vesentlige endringer i dette grunnlaget før leverandører inviteres til å gi tilbud. Oppdragsgiver tar forbehold om avlysning av konkurransen, blant annet i forbindelse med budsjettmessig dekning. Denne anskaffelsen er etter sin art vurdert til å ha en uvesentlig innvirkning på klima og miljø, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5b tredje ledd. Begrunnelsen for dette er at anskaffelsen gjelder kjøp av en digital løsning for den offentlige tannhelsetjenesten der anskaffelsens art medfører at oppdragsgiver er avskåret fra å påvirke klima og miljøpåvirkningen, siden krav og kriterier som retter seg mot disse elementene ikke vil ha tilstrekkelig tilknytning til leveransen, jf. DFØs miljøveileder. Plikten til å stille krav om lærling er vurdert til å gjelde for denne anskaffelsen, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5h. Se kontrakten for mer informasjon.

title: Skiltgjenkjenning og infotavler i Drøbak sentrum

Et utkast til selve konkurransegrunnlaget er lagt ved dette kvalifiseringsgrunnlaget. Oppdragsgiver forbeholder seg retten til å foreta mindre, ikke vesentlige endringer i dette grunnlaget før leverandører inviteres til å gi tilbud. Det er et krav at leverandøren senest ved oppstart av kontraktarbeidene er tilknyttet en lærlingordning, at minst ti prosent av arbeidet utføres av lærlinger og at minst en person av de som deltar i arbeidet med å oppfylle kontrakten skal være en lærling, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5h.

title: Third Party Expert Witness Recruiter
description: The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) requires recruitment services to identify and recommend potential highly qualified experts to be retained by the CRA to assist with litigations. These services include identifying candidates that would meet the requirements provided by the Department of Justice, outlining the requirements of the case. The period of the resulting contract will be one (1) year from the date of contract award. This requirement also includes options to extend the contract up to four (4) additional one-year periods under the same conditions. A bid must comply with the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. The responsive bid with the highest combined rating of technical merit and price will proceed with the conditions precedent to contract award. The Work or a portion of the Work performed under the Contract will be performed on an as-and-when-requested basis and initiated using a Task Authorization (TA). The Work must be completed in accordance with the description of the Work defined in Annex A: Statement of Work and the TA. Proposal documents and supporting information must be submitted in either English or French. Questions must be directed in writing to Furqana Mehkari via email at Furqana.Mehkari@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids must be submitted by using the Connect service provided by the Canada Post Corporation. When responding, the proposal MUST be delivered to: Canada Revenue Agency Bid Receiving Unit BRUg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids will not be accepted if emailed directly to this email address. This email address must be used to request that CRA open a Connect conversation, as detailed in Standard Instructions 2003. Bidders must not use their own licensing agreement for Connect to initiate a Connect conversation with CRA. The CRA reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. The Federal Contractors Program (FCP) for employment equity applies to this procurement. This procurement follows Request for Information (RFI) number: 1000551926 This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document.

title: Senior Leader Cutterhead Dredge Forum
description: On Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the Senior Leader Cutterhead Dredge Forum will provide a platform for collaboration focused on challenges and opportunities in the cutterhead dredging industry. This forum is open to all cutterhead dredging companies that are currently performing business in the New Orleans District or are interested in doing so. The dredge forum will provide an opportunity for dredging industry leaders to meet with USACE senior leaders and technical personnel to discuss New Orleans District dredging projects and funding. There will be two (2) attendee slots (leadership positions) available per company. If your company is interested in attending, please complete one registration form for each company and submit no later than October 16, 2026. Should an attendee/company have a question they would like to be discussed at the forum, please submit the inquiries via email to Yojna Calix at Yojna.Calix@usace.army.mil and Ashley Wainright at Ashley.Wainright@usace.army.mil, no later than 25 September 2026. Time: 9:00am - 12:00pm (CST) Location: USACE New Orleans District Headquarters District Assembly Room (DARM) 7400 Leake Avenue New Orleans, LA 70118 This event is free of charge. All attendees will be required to Pre-register for the event for attendance and to gain access to the installation. Each company should submit one registration with both attendees� information. Furthermore, information about the company's cutterhead dredges, as well as dredging experience in the last three years, will be a part of the registration submittal and must be completed. TO REGISTER: Please register at: https://form.jotform.com/251965714470159 The acquisition forecast information does not represent a pre-solicitation notice or a Request for Quotation/Proposal and is not a commitment by the Government to purchase products or services. We look forward to meeting with you.

description: The Federal Prison Industries (FPI) intends to solicit and award a competitively negotiated Architect and Engineer (A&E) Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ), Multiple Award Contract needed for new construction, renovation, alteration and repairs. The Architect and Engineer (A&E) shall furnish professional architectural, engineering, and related technical services, as specified herein, to the United States Government, Department of Justice, Federal Prison Industries (FPI). The resulting contracts will consist of a one?year base period and will include options for four additional one?year periods. All work performed under this contract shall pertain to projects located at FPI facilities within the contiguous United States. Pursuant to the terms of this contract, the A&E may be required to perform services under the following major categories, including other closely related services as necessary: � Review design and construction documents prepared by other A&E firms or by FPI personnel. � Prepare, develop, and produce design and construction documents for new facility construction, facility additions, and renovation or modernization of existing facilities. � Develop detailed and accurate cost estimates for construction activities, renovations, contract modifications, and claims. � Conduct Value Engineering (V/E) analyses and perform additional cost evaluation studies, as required. � Develop, maintain, and update project schedules and construction schedules. � Provide assistance in preventing, mitigating, and resolving disputes or claims arising from design or construction activities. � Furnish comprehensive architectural and engineering services encompassing all disciplines necessary to ensure the successful execution and completion of assigned projects. � Provide, as required, studies; design development; construction documents; technical specifications; support during bid negotiation; construction administration; and project closeout services. � Develop procedures, prepare construction documents and work statements, support master planning efforts, conduct regulatory compliance evaluations, and assist in the preparation of design?build documentation. � Prepare construction specifications that uphold the principles of full and open competition. � Comply with all general requirements applicable to task orders issued under this contract. In accordance with the Brooks Architect-Engineer Act, award(s) shall be made to the successful firm(s) based on demonstrated competence and qualifications to perform the services at fair and reasonable prices. Prior to this solicitation issuance, technical evaluations were conducted. This solicitation was then issued to the most highly rated firm(s). Therefore, in response to the solicitation, consideration for a contract award will be based solely upon the hourly rates, overhead and profit that are proposed and found to be fair and reasonable. Offerors are advised that award maybe made without discussions. Therefore, the initial proposal should provide sufficient information to recommend award without discussions and should reflect the offeror�s ability to perform at a reasonable price.

title: Solicitation - Residential Reentry Services and Home Confinement Services within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island.
description: Request for Proposal (RFP) - 15BRRC26R00000009 Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services and Home Confinement (HC) services for male and female offenders located within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC facility. The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes which are located within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work (SOW) entitled, �Residential Reentry Center, March, 2022�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four one-year options periods. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 8 beds (8 males and 0 females) and an estimated maximum 20 beds facility in which 18 beds will be designated for males and 2 beds designated for females. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 3 placements and an estimated maximum 8 placements to include both male and female. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. 15BRRC26R00000009 will be available on or about August 28, 2026, and it will be distributed solely through the General Services Administration's Federal Business Opportunities website at https://SAM.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be available. The site provides downloading instructions. Future information about this acquisition will also be distributed through this site. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring this site to ensure that they have the most up-to-date information about this acquisition. The estimated closing date of this solicitation (RFP) will be after 60 days around October 27, 2026. All responsible sources may submit a proposal which will be considered by this agency. No collect calls will be accepted. No telephone request or written requests for the solicitation will be accepted.

title: Robotic Sheet Metal Forming CAPABILITY REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
description: This is a Capability Request for Information (CRFI) issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) and does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with responding to this notice. The United States Air Force Rapid Sustainment Office (RSO) is conducting market research analysis to identify existing solutions for an on-demand, dieless robotic sheet metal forming capability. This capability is intended to produce structural components, brackets, panels, skin sections, and spare parts for support equipment, and aircraft at depot, maintenance, or factory-level facilities. Traditional manufacturing of sheet metal parts relies on heavy, expensive tooling, dies, and presses that require long lead times, high upfront costs, and physical storage. Robotic sheet metal forming�utilizing dual-sided or single-sided synchronized robotic arm manipulators equipped with generic, interchangeable forming styli�offers a flexible, software-defined alternative. The objective of this research is to identify commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) or rapidly adaptable solutions capable of being integrated into standard industrial manufacturing and maintenance facilities. This capability is aimed at reducing reliance on traditional supply chains, eliminating the need for part-specific hard tooling, and dramatically accelerating low-volume manufacturing and prototyping cycles. Submitters are encouraged to highlight existing commercial technologies and details on how their hardware and software solutions can be integrated into industrial DoW facilities. Submitters may also identify optional services, such as operator training, technical support, tooling/stylus consumables, and system maintenance. See the attachment with this notice for additional details.

title: Germany – Public road transport services – Nutzung von 25 Stellplätzen im öffentlichen Straßenraum für den Betrieb mit stationsbasiertem Carsharing im Stadtgebiet Mainz
description: Im Rahmen des Projekts „Weiterentwicklung Carsharing“ stellt die Landeshauptstadt Mainz 25 Stellplätze im öffentlichen Straßenraum für den Betrieb mit stationsbasiertem Carsharing zur Verfügung. Für die Nutzung der Stellplätze wird eine straßenrechtliche Sondernutzungserlaubnis für die Dauer von 6 Jahren erteilt. Die Stellplätze werden im Rahmen eines einheitlichen Auswahlverfahrens an einen Carsharing-Anbieter vergeben. Der Carsharing-Anbieter ist verpflichtet, auf allen 25 Stellplätzen dauerhaft ein Carsharing-Angebot während der gesamten Laufzeit der straßenrechtlichen Sondernutzungserlaubnis zu betreiben. Dabei agiert der Carsharing-Anbieter wirtschaftlich selbstständig. Er trägt das wirtschaftliche Risiko der Unternehmung und leistet die Administration und Disposition. Er trägt die Verantwortung für ein wirksames Marketing des Carsharing-Angebotes. Die Abrechnung des Carsharing-Angebots hat exakt, anhand der tatsächlichen gebuchten Zeitintervalle und der gefahrenen Kilometer, zu erfolgen. Das Carsharing hat ausschließlich stationsbasiert zu erfolgen - es ist kein free-floating oder stationsflexibler Betrieb zulässig.

In addition, new facilities will be established in the basement between anna heimeteneste and physiotherapy. See part II - the contract documentation for further information on the project, contract division and the contract work. The contract ́s start date is 30.11.2026, with the expected completion dated 30.11.2029. (engineering design phase 4 months, start-up addition April -27, estimated construction time extension 18 months + renovation 12 months + 2 months slack = 36 months). For this part of the contract, works at the construction site can start as soon as nautical permits are in place, and the host need for the season added it, tentatively January 2027. title: Denmark – Construction work – Transformerstation til Kalundborg Forsyning, Udvidelse af Renseanlæg (F1.EL.01)
description: Kalundborg Central Renseanlæg (herefter ”KCR”) skal udvides som en konsekvens af, at industrien i Kalundborg Kommune i de kommende år forøger sin tilledning. Udvidelsen af KCR (herefter ”Projektet”) sker både for at øge den biologiske kapacitet af anlægget, bedre styring af overløb, ny slamafvanding og fjernelse af miljøfremmede stoffer gennem tredje og fjerde renseanlæg. Projektet realiseres gennem en række udbud inden for byggeri- og anlæg, maskin- og el, systemleverandører og SRO. Kalundborg Renseanlæg A/S (”Bygherre”) har indgået en totalrådgiveraftale med Envidan A/S, som forestår teknisk rådgivning og bistand, projektering, byggeledelse og processpecialistrådgivning i forbindelse med Projektets realisering. Dette udbud omfatter en hovedentreprisekontrakt, som i hovedtræk indebærer udførelse af følgende arbejder: - Ny elforsyning til ny hovedfordelings el-tavle fra 10 kV ringforbindelse - Ny transformerstation, inkl. komplet teknikhus - Hovedfordelingstavle - Jordingsanlæg Maskine- og elarbejderne forbundet med at realisere procestrinene udbydes i et særskilt udbud. Foruden pris på de faste ydelser, som er forbundet med at realisere kontrakten, skal tilbudsgiverne afgive pris(er) på følgende option: - Tilbudslistens post 4.8: Option: Ydelse for ny elforsyning Deudover skal tilbudsgiverne i tilbudslisten prissætte variable ydelser, herunder reguleringspriser, som kommer til anvendelse, i det omfang, der er behov herfor. Bygherre har overvejet, om indkøbet kan opdeles yderligere, men vurderer, at en yderligere opdeling vil indebære en række uhensigtsmæssige tekniske og juridiske grænseflader med deraf følgende risiko for forhindringer i udførelsesfasen samt afledte transaktionsomkostninger.

title: Y1DA--534-24-706 EHRM Data Center Upgrades Construction - Charleston
description: INTRODUCTION The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) anticipates soliciting bids and subsequently awarding a single firm-fixed-price contract for the design-bid-build EHRM Data Cetner Upgrades Construction project at the Ralph H Johnson VA Medical Center (VAMC) located in Charleston, SC. PROJECT DESCRIPTION The Charleston VAMC is seeking a general contractor to furnish all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision and perform all work necessary to complete the EHRM Data Center Construction project as required by drawings and specifications. The contractor will provide all supervision, labor, equipment, and materials needed to complete work for project 534-24-706, Data Center Upgrades per the provided drawings, specifications, and this statement of work. Work will consist of demolition and renovation of an approximate 1,000 GSF of B200 Computer Room and associated HVAC equipment on the roof. An addition, it will consist of infrastructure upgrades within main computer room. Reconfiguration to maximum space efficiencies within the existing footprint, redundant power distribution, UPS, upgrade computer room cooling and distribution, replacement of aged equipment building, management system interfaces, fire protection, grounding and bonding, cable management, fiber and copper within data center, and raised floor modifications. ADMINISTRATIVE The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bids (IFB) conducted in accordance with FAR Part 14 and will be evaluated in accordance with the procedures listed in the solicitation. The solicitation will be issued as a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. Offers received from other than SDVOSB concerns will not be considered. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220 with a size standard of $45.0 million. The solicitation will be issued in late-July 2026. The period of performance is approximately 365 calendar days from the issuance of the Notice to Proceed (NTP). In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $2,000,000 and $5,000,000. This notice is not a request for competitive offers. All questions must be submitted in writing to the issuing office via email to bailey.donato@va.gov. Telephone calls will not be accepted.

Brak podziału zamówienia minimalizuje ww. ryzyka, albowiem to jeden Wykonawca będzie analizował występujące problemy i sam je rozwiązywał najszybciej jak to technicznie jest możliwe. Dodatkowo Wykonawca zobowiązany będzie przedłożyć wraz z ofertą dowody potwierdzające spełnienie (przez oferowane przez Wykonawcę rozwiązanie równoważne) wymogów Zamawiającego w postaci certyfikatu wydanego przez jednostkę oceniającą zgodność lub sprawozdania z badań przeprowadzonych przez tę jednostkę. Zamawiający zaakceptuje również inne odpowiednie przedmiotowe środki dowodowe przedłożone przez Wykonawcę, w szczególności dokumentację techniczną producenta, a w przypadku gdy dany Wykonawca nie ma ani dostępu do certyfikatów lub sprawozdań z badań, o których wyżej mowa, ani możliwości ich uzyskania w odpowiednim terminie, o ile ten brak dostępu nie może być przypisany danemu Wykonawcy oraz pod warunkiem, że Wykonawca udowodni, że wykonywane przez niego dostawy lub usługi spełniają wymagania, cechy lub kryteria określone w opisie przedmiotu zamówienia lub kryteriów oceny ofert lub wymagania związane z realizacją zamówienia. 6.4.2.Zamawiający informuje, że w przypadku użycia w treści SWZ, znaków towarowych, patentów lub pochodzenia, źródła lub szczególnego procesu, który charakteryzuje produkty lub usługi dostarczane przez konkretnego Wykonawcę, Zamawiający dopuszcza rozwiązanie równoważne, pod warunkiem, iż oferowany przedmiot zamówienia będzie o takich samych lub lepszych parametrach technicznych, merytorycznych, cechach użytkowych, jakościowych, funkcjonalnych. title: Netherlands – Construction supervision services – 22606 | Directievoering t.b.v. Nieuwbouw Kantoor- en Trainingsgebouw te Rijen
description: Het verzorgen van Directievoering ten behoeve van nieuwbouw kantoor- en trainingsgebouw op de vliegbasis Gilze Rijen. De nieuwbouw ten behoeve van de Koninklijke Luchtmacht huisvest kantoor- en trainingsruimtes en daarbij ondersteunende facilitaire ruimtes. Het gebouw is onderdeel van het CLRS (Commando Lucht- en Ruimtestrijdkrachten) op Defensie terrein. De trainingsruimtes omvatten met name ruimtes om de primaire bedrijfsvoering voor te bereiden. De hoofdtaken van de directievoerder staan omschreven in de bijlage ‘22606 - ABAA DNR - X-lijst – Directievoering’ en in de bijlage ‘22606 – ABAA DNR – Opdrachtomschrijving’. De directievoerder voert de directie conform de UAV en vertegenwoordigt de Opdrachtgever tijdens de uitvoerings- en nazorgfase van het project. Uitgangspunt voor de uitvoering zijn de RAW en Stabu bestekken op basis van de UAV. Het te realiseren bouwwerk omvat ca. 8000 m2 BVO (ca. 45 X 100 m1). De nieuwbouw bestaat gedeeltelijk uit 2 bouwlagen met deels een kelder. De hoofddraagconstructie bestaat uit beton en hout, de bouwkundige schil dient te worden gebouwd als EMD schil: volgens de principes van de ‘kooi van faraday’ – het weerhouden van elektromagnetische straling. De nieuwbouw betreft vooral een gebouw met complexe installaties op koel, ventilatie en meet- en regeltechniek. De elektrotechnische installaties bestaan uit hoofdzakelijk: hoog- en laagspanningsinstallatie, data-, brandveiligheid- en elektronische beveiligingsinstallatie.

L'administration communale souhaite rénover/démolir/reconstruire ces bâtiments et regrouper tous ses services en un même lieu : l'administration communale, le CPAS, le service à la population, ainsi que mutualiser la cafétéria, les vestiaires et les parkings avec le centre sportif. La salle des mariages, le CPAS et le bâtiment du service à la population seront, quant à eux démolis. Le marché est divisé en lots comme suit : -Lot N° 1 : Architecture, Stabilité, ascenseur (+ maintenance), démolition, abords et coordination des autres lots. -Lot N° 2 : Electricité, détection incendie (+ maintenance) et panneaux photovoltaïques -Lot N° 3 : HVAC, sanitaire (+ maintenance) Coordination des LOTS : Le présent marché prévoit la désignation de l’entreprise du LOT 1 en tant qu’ENTREPRISE COORDINATRICE et les entreprises des LOT 2 et LOT 3 en tant qu' ENTREPRISES COORDONNÉES. Cette coordination est assurée par l’entreprise coordinatrice moyennant un « FEE » de coordination correspondant à sa rémunération pour toutes les prestations de coordination décrites dans le présent cahier des charges. Par le simple fait de remettre offre, les soumissionnaires des LOTS coordonnés marquent leur accord sans réserve sur la procédure définie au présent cahier spécial des charges. L'entreprise coordinatrice assure la mission de pilotage, c’est-à-dire la planification (L’ENTREPRISE COORDINATRICE établit le planning général des travaux en y intégrant le planning d’exécution particulier du LOT 2, et LOT 3 coordonnés), la coordination, et l’organisation du chantier jusqu'à la bonne fin des travaux (y compris réception définitive). Elle assume également, en dehors des charges inhérentes à l'exécution de sa propre entreprise, la mise à disposition des installations sanitaires (conformément au code sur le bien-être au travail) et autres éléments relatifs à l’installation de chantier (repris dans les clauses techniques) pour les entreprises coordonnées. A cet égard, chaque ENTREPRISE COORDONNÉE s'engage et s'oblige à satisfaire aux obligations notifiées pour l'ENTREPRISE COORDINATRICE.

title: Germany – Analysis services – Rahmenvereinbarung zur Analytik von Umweltproben
description: Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Analytik vorgegebener Parameter aus den Probenmatrices Abwasser und Sickerwasser, Oberflächenwasser (Fließgewässer/stehende Gewässer), Grundwasser und ggfs. Feststoffproben. Die Analyseverfahren werden vom Auftraggeber vorgegeben. Der Probentransport zum Labor des Aufragnehmers erfolgt durch den Aufragnehmer entweder durch eigene Kurierfahrer oder durch geeignete Kurierdienste. Die Prüfergebnisse sind dem Auftraggeber in digitaler Form als Ergebnistabellen (Datei-Format CSV oder XML) gemäß dem vom Auftraggeber vorgegebenen Dateiaufbau sowie als unveränderliche PDF-Prüfberichte zur Verfügung zu stellen. Ziel ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit mehreren Teilnehmern. Die Rahmenvereinbarung nimmt alle Bieter auf, die fachlich geeignet sind und ein form- und fristgerechtes Angebot einreichen. Eine maximale Beschränkung der Teilnehmeranzahl ist nicht vorgesehen. Nach Angebotsöffnung und -prüfung erstellt der Auftraggeber im Rahmen der Wertung eine Platzierungsliste / Rangliste pro ausgeschriebenen Parameter bzw. Parametergruppe, also pro Einzelposition des Preis-/Leistungsverzeichnisses (Teil 5 der Vergabeunterlagen, Tabellenblatt A-Parameterliste). Der Bieter mit dem wirtschaftlichsten Angebot für die Einzelposition erhält jeweils den Zuschlag für den betreffenden Einzelauftrag, in dem er in der Rangfolge auf Platz 1 steht. Unabhängig von der Platzierung ihres Angebotes werden alle Bieter, die für die jeweilige Position ein wertbares Angebot abgegeben haben, in die Rahmenvereinbarung aufgenommen. Die Bedingungen für die Einzelabrufe sind festgeschrieben, innerhalb des festgeschriebenen Vertragszeitraumes es erfolgt kein Mini-Wettbewerb. Für das optionale dritte und vierte Vertragsjahr erfolgt jeweils ein Mini-Wettbewerb mit Preisabfrage, in der sich die Rangfolge ändern kann.

title: Switzerland – Electron microscopes – Scanning electron microscope for imaging and quantitative analysis in geological samples
description: The Institute of Geochemistry and Petrology at ETH Zürich is seeking to upgrade its existing analytical scanning electron microscope (SEM) for a new SEM equipped with a field emission gun, secondary electrons detector (SE) and high-performance backscattered electron detectors (BSE), and a state-of-the-art large area (≥ 100 mm2) energy dispersive spectrometer (EDS). Among several options, we welcome offers for panchromatic and/or entry-level monochromatic cathodoluminescence detector. The main goal of this instrument will be to provide precise and accurate quantitative analyses by EDS using a rigorous quantification protocol that includes the use of reference materials and a full matrix correction (ZAF, phi-rho-z, or equivalent). The instrument should have a large chamber to allow a minimum of 3 petrographic thin sections and 6 one-inch epoxy round mounts. It should be programmable so that we run series of >24 hours of automated quantitative EDS analyses. For further details, please refer to the specifications.

title: Belgium – Construction work – Marché de travaux pour la rénovation et l'extension de l'Administration communale ainsi que du centre sportif de la commune de TROOZ
description: Objet des travaux : Rénovation et extension de l’Administration communale ainsi que du centre sportif de la commune Situation et lieux d’exécution : Les bâtiments se situent : 22 rue de l’Eglise à 4870 TROOZ Parcelles: TROOZ B442s, B441m3, B442t, B442n et B452m. Programme : En juillet 2021, les bâtiments du service de l'administration communale de TROOZ et les bâtiments qui l'entourent, comprenant le hall sportif, la salle des mariages, le CPAS et le service à la population, ont été inondés. L'administration communale souhaite rénover/démolir/reconstruire ces bâtiments et regrouper tous ses services en un même lieu : l'administration communale, le CPAS, le service à la population, ainsi que mutualiser la cafétéria, les vestiaires et les parkings avec le centre sportif. Afin de valoriser le patrimoine architectural de la commune, celle-ci désire rénover le bâtiment de l'administration communale (bâtiment en front de terrain) ainsi que le hall sportif. La salle des mariages, le CPAS et le bâtiment du service à la population seront, quant à eux démolis. title: Norway – Portable computers – Student PCs
description: Background and purpose The current contract expires in October 2026 and a new contract is needed. The objective of the framework agreement is to ensure Innlandet County a comprehensive and cost efficient system for the procurement, delivery and management of pupil PCs for sixth form education. The system shall support the curriculum and digital learning processes in a way that gives students stable, functional and educational relevant work tools throughout the entire school run. The pupils keep the PCs after schooling. It is planned to enter into parallel framework agreements with three tenderers (provided that there are at least 3 tenders that can be accepted). The three tenderers who have the best relationship between price and quality, cf. the award criteria, will be chosen as suppliers. The winner of the competition for the framework agreement will be awarded a contract for delivery 2027. Thereafter, mini-competitions will be held every year. If there is only one tender that is accepted, the duration of the framework agreement will be limited to one year, i.e. delivery 2027. The framework agreement shall provide predictability in both price and quality, at the same time as facilitating flexibility with technological changes and adaptations to educational needs. Good logistics, high delivery precision and easy handling for schools are central, so that the pupils have access to the equipment on time and with minimal administrative work for the county. The agreement shall ensure a uniform, efficient and traceable process for registering, processing and completing all cases related to pupil PCs (claims, insurance, guarantee, repair/replacement) so that schools and ICT personnel have predictable response times, repair times and clear status in the entire course of the case. The machines shall be delivered for 2027 with operating system MS Windows 11 Pro Education or newer, as this is necessary to ensure compatibility with the contracting authority ́s existing system portfolio and management. A need may arise during the contract period for clients based on other operating systems, including Apple Mac. Tenderers shall be able to offer relevant products in accordance with this if the need arises.

Les dispositifs de sûreté à déployer regroupent notamment les métiers suivant de manière non-exhaustive : - Vidéoprotection - Vidéosurveillance - Contrôle d'accès - Détection anti-intrusion - Interphonie - Objets connectés La description des prestations attendues et leurs spécifications techniques sont indiquées au sein du cahier des clauses techniques particulières (C.C.T.P.).

title: Slovakia – Refuse collection services – Nakladanie s komunálnymi odpadmi a drobnými stavebnými odpadmi na území mesta Košice
description: Predmet zákazky je rozdelený na dve časti: 1. Časť – Komunálny odpad (ZKO) Predmetom zákazky je poskytovanie služieb v oblasti nakladania s komunálnymi odpadmi v zmysle tohto opisu predmetu zákazky, okrem iného služieb spojených so zberom, odvozom a spracovaním komunálnych odpadov, dezinfekciou a čistením zberných nádob, ako aj prevádzkovanie zberných dvorov na území mesta Košice vrátane zabezpečenia triedeného zberu. Požiadavky verejného obstarávateľa na zabezpečenie triedeného zberu sú uvedené v Časti 1 bode 1.3 Opisu predmetu zákazky. Služby je potrebné zabezpečiť v súlade s hierarchiou odpadového hospodárstva vyplývajúcou zo zákona č. 79/2015 Z. z. o odpadoch a o zmene a doplnení niektorých zákonov v znení neskorších predpisov (ďalej len „Zákon o odpadoch“) a s ďalšími súvisiacimi právnymi predpismi. Predpokladaný termín začatia poskytovania služby je 1. január 2027. Doba trvania poskytovania služby je stanovená na 120 mesiacov, t. j. do 31. decembra 2036 v prípade účinnosti zmluvy od 01.01.2027. Ak sa tak nestane doba trvania zmluvy bude 120 mesiacov od účinnosti zmluvy. S výnimkou prevádzky zberných dvorov sa všetky služby musia začať poskytovať ku dňu účinnosti zmluvy. V prípade, ak v čase začatia poskytovania služieb nebude dostupný požadovaný počet zberných dvorov, ich uvedenie do prevádzky sa riadi podmienkami špecifikovanými v časti venovanej zberným dvorom, pričom sa umožňuje ich zriadenie a sprevádzkovanie v troch etapách, ako je uvedené ďalej v opise predmetu zákazky. Mesto Košice ako verejný obstarávateľ deklaruje v rámci svojich kompetencií súčinnosť pri legislatívnych a vecných krokoch nevyhnutných na riadne a efektívne poskytovanie predmetných služieb, vrátane zabezpečenia potrebných povolení, informovania obyvateľstva a koordinácie vývoja systému odpadového hospodárstva na svojom území. 2. Časť – Kuchynsky rozložiteľný biologický odpad (KBO) Predmetom zákazky je poskytovanie služieb v oblasti nakladania s komunálnym odpadom (biologicky rozložiteľný kuchynský odpad – katalógové číslo odpadu 20 01 08) v zmysle tohto opisu predmetu zákazky, a to služieb spojených so zberom, odvozom a spracovaním biologicky rozložiteľného kuchynského odpadu. Služby je potrebné zabezpečiť v súlade s hierarchiou odpadového hospodárstva vyplývajúcou zo zákona č. 79/2015 Z. z. o odpadoch a o zmene a doplnení niektorých zákonov v znení neskorších predpisov (ďalej len „Zákon o odpadoch“) a s ďalšími súvisiacimi právnymi predpismi. Predpokladaný termín začatia poskytovania služby je 1. január 2027. Doba trvania poskytovania služby je stanovená na 120 mesiacov, t. j. do 31. decembra 2036 v prípade účinnosti zmluvy od 01.01.2027. Ak sa tak nestane doba trvania zmluvy bude 120 mesiacov od účinnosti zmluvy. Služby sa musia začať poskytovať ku dňu účinnosti zmluvy. Mesto Košice ako verejný obstarávateľ deklaruje v rámci svojich kompetencií súčinnosť pri legislatívnych a vecných krokoch nevyhnutných na riadne a efektívne poskytovanie predmetných služieb, vrátane zabezpečenia potrebných povolení, informovania obyvateľstva a koordinácie vývoja systému odpadového hospodárstva na svojom území.

description: Предмет на откритата процедура е избор на изпълнители на обществена поръчка за „Инженеринг - проектиране, строителството и авторски надзор за енергийно обновяване на многофамилна жилищна сграда в град Девня, община Девня- Енергийно обновяване на многофамилна жилищна сграда, находяща се в град Девня, ул. Райко Даскалов бл. 70 във връзка с процедура „Подкрепа за устойчиво енергийно обновяване на жилищния сграден фонд - Етап I" В предметния обхват на настоящата обществена поръчка са включени дейностите: Дейност 1: проектиране - изготвяне на инвестиционни проекти във фаза „технически проект“, съгласно Наредба № 4 от 21.05.2001 г. за обхвата и съдържанието на инвестиционните проекти, ЗУТ и подзаконовите нормативни актове по прилагането му на строежи/обекти ​​​​​​ Дейност 2: строителство/СМР - изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи и всякакви други съпътстващи и свързани дейности, необходими за изпълнение на строителството, в съответствие с нормативните изисквания, изискванията на Възложителя на строежи/обекти ​​​​​​​ Дейност 3: авторски надзор - упражняване на авторски надзор по време на изпълнение на строежи/обекти ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ ​​​​​​​Изпълнението включва следните дейности, които са свързани с проектиране строителство и експлоатация на обекта и представляват условие, следствие или допълнение към тях: Направа Оценка за наличие на защитени видове при реализация на енергийно обновяване многофамилни жилищни сгради по Плана за възстановяване и устойчивост. Разходите за оценката са за сметка на Изпълнителя. Преглед и анализ на съществуващия Доклад за резултатите от обследването за установяване на техническите характеристики на сградата и на Техническия паспорт на строежа; Преглед и анализ на съществуващия Доклад от извършеното обследване за енергийните характеристики на сградата; Преглед и анализ на оценка за наличие на защитени видове в сградата; Архитектурно заснемане на сградата и геодезическо заснемане на прилежащия терен, при необходимост; Допълнителни проучвания при необходимост, включително подробен оглед на обекта за отразяване на евентуално настъпилите промени след етапа на изготвяне на Обследването за енергийна ефективност (например подменена допълнително дограма и други). Изпълнителят следва да уведоми Възложителя, който осъществява координацията по предварителните проектни дейности; Изготвяне на инвестиционен проект във фаза „Технически проект“ за обекта/секциите от сградата, в обхват и със съдържание съгласно Наредба № 4 от 21.05.2001 г. за обхвата и съдържанието на инвестиционните проекти, законовите и подзаконовите нормативни актове на Република България и в съответствие с изискванията на Възложителя и със задължителните предписания на Докладите за резултатите от обследването за установяване на техническите характеристики на строежа и от извършеното обследване за енергийна ефективност на съответната секция от сградата; Извършване от Изпълнителя на всички необходими дейности по съгласуване на инвестиционния проект с Възложителя и съгласуването на проекта с централни и териториални администрации, специализирани контролни органи и експлоатационни дружества когато такива се налагат; Таксите/разходите за съгласуване и одобрение с изключение на тези към Възложителя са за сметка на Изпълнителя. Отразяване на направените препоръки и забележки в хода на съгласувателните процедури с Възложителя, централни и териториални администрации, специализирани контролни органи и експлоатационни дружества, и на извършване на оценката за съответствие на инвестиционния проект с основните изисквания към строежите от Консултанта; Получаване на всички необходими становища и разрешения, необходими за извършване на неговата работа, съгласно българското законодателство; Законосъобразно, качествено и срочно започване, изпълнение и завършване на строителството, включително доставка на строителни продукти, механизация, работна сила и всякакви услуги и дейности, необходими за изпълнение на строителството в съответствие с техническите спецификации и инвестиционните проекти, съгласно Закона за устройство на територията (ЗУТ) и подзаконовите нормативни актове по прилагането му, всички други действащи нормативни документи, Договора за изпълнението и др.; Своевременно съставяне на актовете и протоколите по време на строителството в съответствие с изискванията на чл. 163, ал. 2, т. 3 от ЗУТ; Съхраняване и предоставяне при поискване от останалите участници в инвестиционния процес или от контролен орган на строителните книжа, заповедната книга на строежа по чл. 170, ал. 3 от ЗУТ, актовете и протоколите, съставени по време на строителството, и друга техническа документация по изпълнението на строежа; Изготвяне на екзекутивна документация съгласно чл. 175 от Закона за устройство на територията; Проби, изпитвания и лабораторни изследвания при завършване на строителните и монтажните работи, където е необходимо; Отстраняване на недостатъците, установени при предаването на Строежа и въвеждането му в експлоатация; Авторски надзор по време на строителството в обем и със съдържание съгласно ЗУТ и подзаконовите нормативни документи по прилагането му; Участие в процедурата по въвеждане на Строежа в експлоатация;​​​​​​​ Отстраняване на всички констатирани дефекти в рамките на гаранционния срок.

description: Die hochrangige Regierungsberatung wird in Staaten in Osteuropa, auf dem Westbalkan, im Südkaukasus und in Zentralasien durchgeführt. Aktuell erfolgt die Beratung in den Ländern Ukraine, Belarus (derzeit ausgesetzt), Moldau, Georgien (derzeit ausgesetzt), Usbekistan und Kosovo. Ab 2027 soll die Beratung in den Ländern Ukraine, Moldau, Usbekistan, Kosovo, Albanien und Nordmazedonien erfolgen. Bei Bereitstellung zusätzlicher Haushaltsmittel ist als weiteres Programmland Armenien vorgesehen. Kern und Voraussetzung für die Akzeptanz der Beratung bei den Regierungen der Zielländer ist die Unabhängigkeit und Nachfrageorientierung der Beratung. Die Beratung wird auf Wunsch und Nachfrage von Institutionen des Partnerlandes erbracht. Die konkreten Themen für die wirtschaftspolitische Beratung werden vorrangig von Institutionen und Regierungsstellen der Partnerländer dem AN oder dem BMWE gegenüber vorgeschlagen. Damit ergänzt die Regierungsberatung das Instrumentarium der Außenwirtschaftsförderinstrumente, die sich vornehmlich an Unternehmen richten. Der AN tritt in der Ausführung des Auftrags als eigenständiger Akteur auf. Der AN hat in Abstimmung mit dem AG auf das Auftragsverhältnis zu verweisen.

Toholammin lomituspalvelut toimivat Alavieskan, Halsuan, Kaustisen, Lestijärven, Kärsämäen, Merijärven, Perhon, Pyhäjoen, Reisjärven, Sievin, Toholammin ja Vetelin kuntien, Haapajärven, Haapaveden, Kalajoen, Kannuksen, Nivalan, Oulaisten, Pyhäjärven, Raahen ja Ylivieskan kaupunkien sekä Kokkolan kaupungista entisten Ullavan, Kälviän ja Lohtajan kuntien alueella. Kyseessä on puitesopimus, joka ei velvoita ostamaan tiettyä määrää lomitusta. Sopimuksen kesto 2 vuotta. Sopimus alkaa 1.1.2027. Tarjouksessa on ilmoitettava yhteyshenkilö yhteystietoineen, toimijan nimi sekä Y-tunnus, jonka nimissä tarjous tehdään. Palveluissa noudatetaan kulloinkin voimassa olevaa Maatalousyrittäjien lomituspalvelulakia (20.12.1996/1231) ja -asetusta (30.12.1996/1333). Tarjous voi koskea kaikkia tuotantoaloja tai yhtä tai useampaa osaa. title: Rahmenvereinbarung zur Analytik von Umweltproben
description: Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Analytik vorgegebener Parameter aus den Probenmatrices Abwasser und Sickerwasser, Oberflächenwasser (Fließgewässer/stehende Gewässer), Grundwasser und ggfs. Feststoffproben. Die Analyseverfahren werden vom Auftraggeber vorgegeben. Der Probentransport zum Labor des Aufragnehmers erfolgt durch den Aufragnehmer entweder durch eigene Kurierfahrer oder durch geeignete Kurierdienste. Die Prüfergebnisse sind dem Auftraggeber in digitaler Form als Ergebnistabellen (Datei-Format CSV oder XML) gemäß dem vom Auftraggeber vorgegebenen Dateiaufbau sowie als unveränderliche PDF-Prüfberichte zur Verfügung zu stellen. Ziel ist der Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit mehreren Teilnehmern. Die Rahmenvereinbarung nimmt alle Bieter auf, die fachlich geeignet sind und ein form- und fristgerechtes Angebot einreichen. Eine maximale Beschränkung der Teilnehmeranzahl ist nicht vorgesehen. Nach Angebotsöffnung und -prüfung erstellt der Auftraggeber im Rahmen der Wertung eine Platzierungsliste / Rangliste pro ausgeschriebenen Parameter bzw. Parametergruppe, also pro Einzelposition des Preis-/Leistungsverzeichnisses (Teil 5 der Vergabeunterlagen, Tabellenblatt A-Parameterliste). Der Bieter mit dem wirtschaftlichsten Angebot für die Einzelposition erhält jeweils den Zuschlag für den betreffenden Einzelauftrag, in dem er in der Rangfolge auf Platz 1 steht. Unabhängig von der Platzierung ihres Angebotes werden alle Bieter, die für die jeweilige Position ein wertbares Angebot abgegeben haben, in die Rahmenvereinbarung aufgenommen. Die Bedingungen für die Einzelabrufe sind festgeschrieben, innerhalb des festgeschriebenen Vertragszeitraumes es erfolgt kein Mini-Wettbewerb. Für das optionale dritte und vierte Vertragsjahr erfolgt jeweils ein Mini-Wettbewerb mit Preisabfrage, in der sich die Rangfolge ändern kann.
